lines.text: Peter stood up with the Eleven and said the men were not drunk, since it was only the third hour.
Peter said Jesus of Nazareth was put to death by nailing Him to the cross, but God raised Him.
Peter said David died and was buried, and his tomb was with them, but David foresaw the Christ's resurrection.
Cut to the heart, the crowd heard Peter say to repent and be baptized, and about five thousand were added.
The believers shared with those in need, met daily in the synagogues, and the Lord added to their number.
